title: InventorySaves+
description: Adds a better saving system compared to the normal vanilla hotbar saves
body:
# Inventory Saves+ 🎒✨
![inventory saves pic](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7b202cbced9eb3f9101e4607a766815dab8e5cb.png)
A full inventory management system for PvP players that goes far beyond vanilla hotbar saves — store, load, and switch complete loadouts in seconds.

## Loadout System 🧠
Save and restore your entire inventory with a single keypress.
How It Works

Save your full inventory to any of 18 available slots
Load any slot to instantly restore your hotbar, armor, offhand, and main inventory
Works exclusively in Creative Mode to keep things server-safe
Async save system means zero lag when writing to disk


## Loadout Manager 🖥️
A clean in-game UI for managing all your saved loadouts.
Features

Scrollable list of all 18 slots with names and status
Inline name editor — rename slots without extra menus
Save, Load, and Delete from one screen
Real-time slot preview with empty/filled state indicators
Scrollbar for navigating large slot lists
Accessible via keybind or ModMenu


## Preset Kits ⚔️
Jump straight into combat with one click using built-in preset loadouts.
PresetDescriptionPot PvPClassic potion PvP kitAxe KitAxe-based combat setupSMP KitGeneral survival multiplayer loadoutMace KitMace-focused combat buildSword KitSword PvP standard kitUHC (Old)Classic UHC-style setupUHC (New)Modern UHC buildNethPotNether potion kitVanilla (Drain)Drain-focused vanilla kitVanilla (Eval)Evaluation vanilla kit
All presets are available directly inside the Loadout Manager.

## HUD Display 🔰
A lightweight, non-intrusive HUD that keeps you informed without cluttering your screen.
Features

Shows active profile name and currently selected slot
Fades in on change, fades out after inactivity — never in your way
Smooth opacity animation with gold accent bar
Text is only generated when something changes, keeping frame impact near zero


## Keybinds ⌨️
Everything is a single keypress away.
ActionDefault KeySave LoadoutKLoad LoadoutLNext Slot]Previous Slot[Open Loadout MenuM
All keybinds are fully remappable in the vanilla Controls menu.

## Save System 💾
Built for speed and reliability.

Batched async I/O — saves never block the main thread
Debounced writes — rapid changes queue into a single disk write
Sparse JSON format — empty slots are skipped entirely, keeping save files small and fast to parse
Saves automatically on every change; loads automatically on world join


## Commands ⚙️
(Coming in a future update — config GUI and command support are on the roadmap)

Why Use Inventory Saves+? 💡
🎒 Save your full inventory — not just your hotbar
⚔️ Switch between PvP kits instantly
🏗️ Keep building, mining, and combat setups ready to go
🎨 Name and organise your slots your way
🔥 Built for competitive Creative Mode PvP and kit testing

Compatibility

Minecraft: 1.21.11
Loader: Fabric
Environment: Client-side only
Optional: ModMenu for settings screen integration
